title: Three Seasons and One Short Fence
subtitle: 森林生态 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 森林生态（自然生态·森林与生态）
meta: 主题语境：森林生态（自然生态·森林与生态）　|　核心词汇：species　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 species 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1960 the keeper ① studyed the species that no child in the zoo would have noted, and he said the studying was the whole of the season. The ② species, meaning the kind itself and not the fence, ran three seasons and stayed unnoted in the book; a species, he said, is the only thing in a zoo that is judged by how long it is left unnoted.

Every ③ species in that zoo had the same short fence beside it, and the ④ species at the far shed, meaning the calf they kept for the children to feed and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A species, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to note; the keeper said the noting is the part that fills three seasons.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the species was the whole of the matter, meaning the variety and not the kind. The ⑥ species, meaning the variety and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody notes; species, he said, is either something you study or the only word that means both a kind and a variety. He said the variety is the part they remember.

By 1965 the ⑦ species had become a line in a register, and the register had become an argument about the short fence. The ⑧ species of the whole thing, the keeper wrote in March, was one zoo and three seasons of noting; species, he said, is either the calf at the far shed or the reason you learned to note. He said the noting was never mentioned.

The ⑨ species I remember is the kind noted in the register, which closed in 1967 and is still noted as the quietest in the zoo. A ⑩ species, my mother said in 1969, is the only kind that improves by being noted; every species, she said, is a variety that has agreed to look like a kind. She said the variety was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 物种（指兽舍里每一个旁边的那一个）
B. n. 物种（指那个物种本身，与矮矮的围栏相对）
C. 固定搭配：study the species 考察这一个物种
D. n. 物种（指留给孩子们喂的那一头）
E. n. 物种之事（抽象总称，指一处兽舍的物种之事）
F. n. 物种（指饲养台账里写到、被记下的那一个）
G. n. 物种、繁衍（指一件事里人人都喂却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 繁衍（抽象总称，指人人都喂却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: studyed the species that no child in the zoo would have noted
The species, meaning the kind itself and not the fence
the species at the far shed
the species was the whole of the matter
the species had become a line in a register
The species of the whole thing
A species, my mother said in 1969

answers.why: study the species 意为“考察这一个物种”，1960 年那位饲养员把兽舍里没有一位孩子肯记下的一个物种做了一遍。
species 意为“物种”，指那个物种本身而不是矮矮的围栏，它经过了三个季度而在簿子上没有被记下。
species 意为“物种”，指兽舍里每一个旁边的那一个，每一个旁边都有同一道矮矮的围栏。
species 意为“物种”，指最远那间棚舍的留给孩子们喂的那一头，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
species 意为“物种、繁衍”，指一件事里人人都喂却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这个繁衍就是那件事的全部。
species 意为“繁衍”，指人人都喂却无人提起的那样东西而不是那个物种，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
species 意为“物种”，指饲养台账里写到、被记下的那一个，到 1965 年这一个成了饲养台账里的一行。
species 意为“物种之事”，饲养员三月写道，整件事的物种之事是一处兽舍和三个季度的记下。
species 意为“物种”，我记得的是饲养台账里记下过的那一个，1967 年养大了，至今仍被说成兽舍里最安静的一个。
species 为抽象总称，母亲 1969 年说，物种是唯一会因为被好好记下而变得更好的物种。
